*This page contains information for projects funded under the Innovative Health Initiative (IHI) as well as the Innovative Medicines Initiative 2 *(IMI2) *programme.*

### Documents for IHI projects

## IHI project reporting documents and guidance

### Periodic report template

The period report consists of two technical parts (A and B) and a financial part. It must be submitted by the project coordinator within 60 days of the end of each reporting period.

**Periodic report template - technical part A**  
Part A is generated by the IT system in the grant management environment. It consists of structured web forms (e.g. summary for publication, deliverables, milestones, dissemination & exploitation of results, etc.) and can be found in the continuous reporting module of the grant management system. Project beneficiaries can update this information at any time during the project's lifetime.

Coordinators should read the <a href="/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/Guidance_IHICoordinators_PeriodicReport_PartA.pdf" target="_blank">IHI-specific guidance for coordinators on how to prepare the periodic technical report - part A</a>  (which focuses on the specificities of IHI JU and offers advice on preparing the content of the forms and deliverables) and the Funding and Tenders Portal <a href="https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/funding-tenders-opportunities/display/IT/Continuous+Reporting" target="_blank">instructions on continuous reporting</a> (which explain step-by-step how to upload information and files to the portal), as well as the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/docs/2021-2027/common/temp-form/report/periodic-report_horizon-euratom_en.pdf" target="_blank">Horizon Europe Part A template</a>.

**Periodic report template - technical part B**  
Part B follows the Horizon Europe template but is tailored to IHI's specificities. It consists of a narrative description of the work carried out during the reporting period. All project beneficiaries should contribute to Part B in the periodic reporting module of the grant management system. The project coordinator should upload part B as a pdf document, review its contents and submit it to IHI within the deadlines.  
View the [IHI-specific part B template](/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IHI_PeriodicReportTemplate_Part_B.docx).

**Periodic report - financial part**  
The financial part of the period report consists of the online financial statements and explanations on the use of resource by project beneficiaries.  
Instructions on how to complete the financial part of the periodic report can be found <a href="https://webgate.ec.europa.eu/funding-tenders-opportunities/pages/viewpage.action?pageId=8913035#Reportingprocess%E2%80%94general-Step2:AllbeneficiariescompletetheirownFinancialPart(FinancialStatement)andtheircontributiontotheTechnicalPartofthePeriodicReport.Beneficiariese-signandsubmittheirFinancialPartstotheCoordinator" target="_blank">here</a>.

**Certificates on the financial statements / contributions (CFS / CCS)**  
At the end of the project, a certificate needs to be uploaded for project beneficiaries who reach the threshold for the CFS (certificate on the financial statements) or CCS (certificate on the statement of contributions).

- Download the <a href="https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/docs/2021-2027/common/temp-form/report/cfs_en.docx" target="_blank">model for the CFS</a> (Word)
- Download the [model for the CCS](/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IHI_CCS_template.docx) (Word)
- Download the [annex to the CFS for hybrid participants](/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IHI_CFS_Hybrid_Annex.docx) (Word)

## IMI2 Model Grant Agreement

The IMI2 JU Model Grant Agreement (MGA) is updated from time to time in line with the wider Horizon 2020 (H2020) MGA. The latest version of the IMI2 MGA can always be found via <a href="http://ec.europa.eu/research/participants/data/ref/h2020/other/mga/jtis/h2020-mga-imi_en.pdf" target="_blank">this link</a>. Links to specific versions, along with the IMI2 Calls they apply to, are given below.

- <a href="/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_MGA_v5_Nov2017.pdf" target="_blank">Version 5</a> of November 2017 (applies to IMI2 - Call 13 on)
- <a href="/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_MGA_v4_May2017.pdf" target="_blank">Version 4</a> of May 2017 (applies to IMI2 - Calls 11 and 12)
- <a href="/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_MGA_v3_Nov2016.pdf" target="_blank">Version 3</a> of November 2016 (applies to IMI2 - Call 10)
- <a href="/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_MGA_v2_Feb2015.pdf" target="_blank">Version 2</a> of February 2015 (applies to IMI2 - Calls 1 to 9 inclusive)

Generally speaking, changes only apply to new Grant Agreements. However, in certain cases (for example when it is advantageous for beneficiaries), changes can be applied retroactively by projects whose Grant Agreements are based on older versions of the Model Grant Agreement. <a href="/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_MGA_VersionDifferences_v2v3v4.pdf" target="_blank">This document</a> explains this in more detail and summarises what is new in later versions compared to earlier versions, and which changes apply retroactively.

**Annotated Model Grant Agreement**

The <a href="/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_AnnotatedMGA.pdf" target="_blank">IMI2 Annotated Model Grant Agreement</a> sets out the specific characteristics of the IMI2 public-private partnership, and helps applicants and project participants to understand and interpret the provisions of the IMI2 JU Model Grant Agreement.

**Grant agreement amendments**

IMI2 Grant Agreement Amendments Guide  - <a href="/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_GrantAgreementAmendmentsGuide.pdf" target="_blank">pdf</a> \| [Word](/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_GrantAgreementAmendmentsGuide.docx)

**Consortium agreement**

All project partners must sign a consortium agreement that sets out participants’ rights and obligations and addresses issues like governance, liability and intellectual property rights. The agreement should be adapted to the needs of each project. A [template](/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_EFPIA_ModelConsortiumAgreement.docx) <a href="https://efpia.eu/media/25823/efpia-model-consortium-agreement-for-imi2-actions-2.docx" target="_blank"></a> [prepared by EFPIA](/sites/default/files/uploads/Documents/ProjectResources/IMI2_EFPIA_ModelConsortiumAgreement.docx) shows what a consortium agreement might look like. Consortia may also use alternative templates if they wish.

## Catch up on the IHI Coordinators' Training Day

To support IHI project coordinators and managers in their management, administration and reporting duties, IHI ran a training day on 21 April 2026. 

The interactive event covered amendments, reporting (both scientific and financial), ex-post audits, communication, and exploitation. 

<a href="https://www.ihi.europa.eu/news-events/events/ihi-coordinators-training-day" class="btn btn-primary" role="button">Find out more <span class="icon-white icon-arrow-right"> </span></a>
